title: BigQuery Data Policy: Advanced Matching Conditions
summary: The BigQuery Data Policy API now supports a new `matchingCondition` property within the `DataPolicy` resource. This allows developers to define data policies using SQL expressions, enabling more dynamic and fine-grained control based on column tags.
details: Developers can now specify a `matchingCondition` as a SQL expression string in the `DataPolicy` schema. This new capability introduces Data Governance Tag matcher functions like `COLUMN_HAS_TAG_KEY(keyName STRING)` and `COLUMN_MATCH_TAG(keyName STRING, valueShortName STRING)`. These functions allow policies to target columns based on the presence or specific value of data governance tags, providing powerful new ways to enforce data policies dynamically.
